paragraphs.en: The captain, having watched Silver disappear, turned towards the interior and found Gray alone. Gray's anger was evident for the first time.
paragraphs.zh: 船长见锡尔弗消失后转身朝内看去，只见格雷独自一人。格雷的愤怒第一次显露了出来。

paragraphs.en: "Quarters!" he barked. "Gray," he continued, "I'll note your name; you've kept your post like a true seaman.
paragraphs.zh: “ quarters！”他喊道。“格雷，”他继续说道，“我会记下你的名字；你坚守岗位，真像一个合格的水手。

paragraphs.en: Mr. Trelawney, I'm disappointed in you. Doctor, if that was how you served at Fontenoy, you'd be better off in bed."
paragraphs.zh: 特拉韦尼先生，我对你失望透了。医生，如果你在丰特诺伊战役中的表现就是这样，你最好还是待在床上休息吧。

paragraphs.en: The doctor and others were back at their posts, faces flushed, each with a task to do—loading spare muskets.
paragraphs.zh: 医生和其他人又各就各位，脸上带着红晕，每个人都有自己的任务——装填备用的火枪。

paragraphs.en: Silently, the captain surveyed the situation for a moment before speaking.
paragraphs.zh: 沉默片刻后，船长环视了一下情况，然后开口说道。

paragraphs.en: "My lads," he said, "I've given Silver a broadside. We'll be boarded soon. We're outnumbered, but we fight in shelter and with discipline.
paragraphs.zh: “各位伙计们，”他说道，“我已经给锡尔弗来了个满舷炮轰。不久他们就会登船了。我们人数处于劣势，但我们可以依托掩护并有条不紊地进行抵抗。

paragraphs.en: I'm confident we can defeat them."
paragraphs.zh: 我相信我们能够战胜他们。

paragraphs.en: He then checked that all was clear, noting two loopholes on the east and west sides, two more on the south porch, and five on the north.
paragraphs.zh: 他检查了一下四周，发现东侧和西侧各有两个漏洞，南门廊上有四个，北面则有五个。

paragraphs.en: For seven of them, there were about twenty muskets; firewood had been arranged into four piles—tables in the middle of each side—with ammunition and four loaded muskets ready. Cutlasses lay ranged in the center.
paragraphs.zh: 对于其中七人，准备了大约二十支火枪；柴火堆成了四堆，每边中间放着一张桌子，并备有弹药和四支上膛的火枪。短刀整齐地排列在中央。

paragraphs.en: "Toss out the fire," ordered the captain. "The chill is past; no smoke allowed."
paragraphs.zh: “把火熄灭,”船长下令道，“寒意已过，不允许有烟。”

paragraphs.en: Mr. Trelawney carried the iron fire-basket outside, smothering the embers with sand.
paragraphs.zh: 特拉温尼先生把铁火盆拿到外面，用沙子扑灭了余烬。

paragraphs.en: "Hawkins hasn't had his breakfast. Help yourself and return to your post," said Captain Smollett. "Lively now, my lad; you'll need it soon.
paragraphs.zh: “霍金斯还没吃早饭。你自便些，然后回到你的岗位上去。”斯莫莱特船长说道，“小伙子，快点行动吧；用得着呢。”

paragraphs.en: Hunter, serve out a round of brandy to all hands."
paragraphs.zh: 亨特，给大家每人倒一杯 BRANDY。

paragraphs.en: As this was happening, the captain finalized his defense plan in his mind.
paragraphs.zh: 就在这时，船长在心中制定了他的防御计划。

paragraphs.en: The captain instructed the group: "Doctor, you'll take the door; Hunter, east; Joyce, west; Mr. Trelawney and Gray, the long north side with five loopholes." He explained the danger if attackers reached that position. Hawkins and he were to reload.
paragraphs.zh: 船长布置任务道：“医生，你负责大门；亨特，向东；Joyce，向西；特拉温尼先生和格雷，负责北面较长的那段，共有五个射击孔。”他解释了如果敌人占据那个位置的危险性。霍金斯和他则要负责重新装填武器。

paragraphs.en: As the sun rose, the chill dissipated. The clearing warmed quickly, and soon the blockhouse's sand was baking. Coats were discarded, and shirts rolled up.
paragraphs.zh: 随着太阳升起，寒意渐渐消散。空地很快暖和起来，不久后，要塞的沙地也开始炙烤。人们脱下了外套，卷起了衬衫袖子。

paragraphs.en: Each man stood at his post, tense with heat and anxiety.
paragraphs.zh: 每个人都在自己的岗位上绷紧了神经，被炎热折磨得焦虑不安。

paragraphs.en: An hour passed. "Hang them!" said the captain, growing impatient.
paragraphs.zh: 一小时过去了。“把他们绞死！”船长不耐烦地说道。

paragraphs.en: "This is as dull as the doldrums." He asked Gray to whistle for a breeze.
paragraphs.zh: “这真是无聊透顶。”他说道，让格雷去吹口哨唤来一丝微风。

paragraphs.en: Suddenly, Joyce fired. The report was quickly followed by scattered volleys from all sides of the enclosure. Several bullets struck the log-house but none penetrated.
paragraphs.zh: 突然，乔伊斯扣动了扳机。枪声很快被围栏各处零星的回响所取代。几颗子弹击中了木屋，但都没有穿透进去。

paragraphs.en: As smoke cleared, the stockade and surrounding woods appeared quiet.
paragraphs.zh: 随着烟雾散去，木栅栏和周围的树林显得格外宁静。

paragraphs.en: "Did you hit your man?" asked the captain.
paragraphs.zh: “你打你的丈夫了？”船长问道。

paragraphs.en: "No, sir," replied Joyce. "I believe not."
paragraphs.zh: “不，先生，”乔伊斯回答，“我不这么认为。”

paragraphs.en: "Next best thing to tell the truth," muttered Smollett. He ordered Hawkins to reload Joyce's gun. "How many do you think were on your side, doctor?"
paragraphs.zh: “其次就是说实话了。”斯莫莱特喃喃道。他命令霍金斯给乔伊斯的枪上膛。“你觉得支持你的人有多少，医生？”

paragraphs.en: Dr. Livesey confirmed, "Three shots were fired from this side—two close together, one farther west."
paragraphs.zh: 莱维斯医生确认道：“从这边开了三枪——两枪几乎连在一起，另一枪偏西一些。”

paragraphs.en: Captain Smollett asked, "And how many from yours, Mr. Trelawney?"
paragraphs.zh: 特雷拉尼先生，你们那边有多少人呢？斯莫莱特船长问道。

paragraphs.en: The answer was not straightforward. The pirates had come from the north in significant numbers—seven according to the squire, eight or nine by Gray's count. Only a single shot each came from the east and west.
paragraphs.zh: 答案并不简单。据管家说，海盗是从北方来的，数量不少——具体是七艘。而格雷统计下来则是八九艘。东边和西边各自只有一两声枪响。

paragraphs.en: Captain Smollett did not alter his plans. If the mutineers crossed the stockade, they would take any unprotected loophole and shoot us like rats in our stronghold.
paragraphs.zh: 斯莫莱特船长并没有改变计划。如果叛乱分子突破了木栅，他们就会利用任何未受保护的缺口向我们射击，就像在要塞里射杀rats一样。

paragraphs.en: Suddenly, with a loud huzza, pirates emerged from the woods on the north side and rushed towards the stockade. At the same moment, gunfire resumed from the woods, and a rifle ball shattered Dr. Livesey's musket as it passed through the doorway.
paragraphs.zh: 突然，一声响亮的叫好声传来，一群海盗从北面树林中冲出，向木栅猛扑过来。与此同时，树林里再次响起枪声，一颗子弹击碎了赖斯利医生手中的步枪，穿过门道飞了过去。

paragraphs.en: The boarders swarmed over the fence like monkeys. Squire and Gray fired repeatedly; three men fell—two outside, one inside. The man who fell inside quickly got up and vanished into the trees.
paragraphs.zh: 板房里的住客像猴子一样蜂拥而上。斯科特和格雷连开了几枪；有三个人应声倒下——两个在屋外，一个被击中倒在了屋内。那个倒在屋内的男子迅速站起身来，消失在了树林之中。

paragraphs.en: Two pirates were dead, one had fled, while four had entered our defenses. From the woods, seven or eight men kept up a hot but ineffective fire on the log-house.
paragraphs.zh: 两名海盗已丧命，一名逃走了，而四名则突破了我们的防线。从树林中，七八个男子不停地向木屋开了几枪，但他们的火力并不算猛烈，也未能造成太大威胁。

paragraphs.en: The four boarders ran towards the building, shouting as they approached. Men in the trees shouted encouragement. Several shots were fired, but none hit their mark due to the haste of the shooters.
paragraphs.zh: 四个房客疾跑向那座建筑，边跑边喊。树上的男人也在为他们加油鼓劲。几声枪响划破夜空，但由于射手们动作匆忙，子弹无一命中目标。

paragraphs.en: In an instant, the four pirates had climbed the mound and were upon us. Job Anderson's head appeared at the middle loophole.
paragraphs.zh: 瞬间，四个海盗爬上了土丘，出现在我们面前。乔布·安德森的头出现在中间的射击孔里。

paragraphs.en: "Fire all hands—fire all hands!" he roared loudly.
paragraphs.zh: “全船的人都给我放下火药桶——全船的人都给我放下火药桶！”他大声吼道。

paragraphs.en: Another pirate seized Hunter's musket by the muzzle, wrenched it away, and thrust it through the loophole. With a single blow, he knocked Hunter senseless to the floor. Meanwhile, another pirate ran unharmed around the house and appeared in the doorway, falling with his cutlass on Dr. Livesey.
paragraphs.zh: 另一名海盗抓住亨特的火枪枪口，强行夺过枪，将枪杆塞进了射击孔。一击之下，他将亨特打得晕了过去，摔倒在地。与此同时，另一个海盗绕过房子安然无恙地来到门口，手持宝剑朝莱维斯医生砍去。

paragraphs.en: Our position had dramatically changed. We were now exposed and unable to retaliate as we had been firing from cover at an enemy.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的处境发生了根本性的变化。现在我们暴露在外，无法像之前那样在掩护下还击敌人了。

paragraphs.en: The log-house was filled with smoke, providing us some safety. Cries, confusion, pistol shots, and a loud groan echoed around me.
paragraphs.zh: 木屋内烟雾弥漫，为我们提供了一些安全保障。喊声、混乱、枪声和一声响亮的呻吟在我周围回荡。

paragraphs.en: "Out, lads, out! Cutlasses!" the captain shouted.
paragraphs.zh: “快出去，伙计们！拔刀！”船长喊道。

paragraphs.en: I grabbed a cutlass and, as someone else did too, I felt a sharp pain on my knuckles but barely noticed it. Rushing outside into the sunlight, I saw Anderson charging down the hill after his attacker. The doctor had already struck him down with a powerful slash across the face.
paragraphs.zh: 我抓起一把短剑，另一个人也跟着做了同样的动作。我的手指突然感到一阵刺痛，但我几乎没注意到。冲出屋外迎着阳光，只见安德森正沿着山坡追击他的对手。医生已经用一记有力的砍刀在对方脸上划了一道，将他击倒在地。

paragraphs.en: "Round the house, lads!" the captain cried. Amidst the chaos, I could sense a shift in his tone.
paragraphs.zh: “全体绕房子跑一圈！”船长喊道。在混乱中，我能感觉到他的语气有了变化。

paragraphs.en: Following orders, I turned east and ran around the corner of the house, raising my cutlass. Suddenly, Anderson appeared before me. He roared loudly, swinging his hanger high above his head.
paragraphs.zh: 遵照指令，我朝东跑去，绕到房子的转角处，高举着短剑。就在这时，安德森突然出现在我的面前。他大声吼叫着，高高地举起他的弯刀。

paragraphs.en: Without time to fear, I dodged to one side but slipped on soft sand, rolling down the slope.
paragraphs.zh: 来不及害怕，我向一侧闪避，却不慎滑倒在柔软的沙地上，顺着坡度滚了下去。

paragraphs.en: When we first left the door, other mutineers were already climbing over the palisade. One man in a red night-cap had even managed to climb up and was halfway across. Despite the short interval, when I regained my footing, everything remained the same: the man with the red night-cap still half-over, another just peeking above the stockade's top.
paragraphs.zh: 当我们刚一离开大门，其他叛乱者就已经开始攀越木栅。一个戴着红夜帽的人竟然已经爬了上去，身子一半已越过木栅。尽管时间不长，当我重新站稳脚跟时，一切依旧如故：那个戴着红夜帽的人依然半悬在木栅之上，另一个则刚刚探出头来。

paragraphs.en: Yet, within this brief moment, the fight ended, and we emerged victorious.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，在这短暂的一瞬，战斗结束了，我们取得了胜利。

paragraphs.en: Gray and I pursued the attackers closely. The big boatswain had been felled before he could recover from his last blow. Another attacker, shot while firing into the house, lay in agony with a smoking pistol still in hand.
paragraphs.zh: 格雷和我紧追不舍，攻击者还没来得及从上一次的打击中恢复过来就被击倒了。另一个正在向屋内射击的攻击者被击中后倒地哀嚎，手中还握着一把冒着烟的手枪。

paragraphs.en: A third, seen by me, was dispatched by the doctor's blow. Only one of the four who scaled the palisade remained; he fled, leaving his cutlass behind.
paragraphs.zh: 第三个被我看见的敌人，则是在医生一击之下命丧黄泉。四个攀越木栅的敌人中，只剩下一人逃走了，他弃下了手中的短剑。

paragraphs.en: "Fire from the house!" shouted the doctor. "Back to cover!"
paragraphs.zh: “屋子里着火了！”医生喊道，“快回去掩蔽！”

paragraphs.en: But no shots were fired as the last attacker escaped into the woods with the others. Within three seconds, only five attackers lay dead—four inside and one outside the palisade.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，在最后一名袭击者逃入树林与同伴会合后，并没有枪声响起。仅仅三秒钟内，共有五名袭击者倒下——四人在栅栏内，一人在栅栏外。

paragraphs.en: We rushed for shelter. The survivors would soon return to their muskets; we feared another attack at any moment. Inside the house, smoke was clearing, revealing the cost of our victory: Hunter lay stunned beside his loophole, while Joyce, shot through the head, remained motionless.
paragraphs.zh: 我们急忙寻找掩护。幸存者们很快会重新拿起他们的步枪；我们担心随时可能再次遭到攻击。屋内烟雾逐渐散去，胜利的代价显露无遗：亨特倒在了射击孔旁，神志不清；乔伊斯则头部中弹，一动不动。

paragraphs.en: In the center, the squire supported the captain, both as pale as each other.
paragraphs.zh: 中间，骑士扶着船长，两人脸色苍白得几乎一样。

paragraphs.en: "The captain's wounded," said Mr. Trelawney.
paragraphs.zh: “船长受伤了，”特拉韦尼先生说道。

paragraphs.en: "Have they run?" asked Mr. Smollett.
paragraphs.zh: “他们逃走了吗？”斯莫莱特先生问道。

paragraphs.en: "All that could have, you may be sure," replied the doctor. "But five will never run again."
paragraphs.zh: “这些全都发生了，”医生肯定地说，“但五个人永远不会再跑了。”

paragraphs.en: "Five!" exclaimed the captain. "That’s better.
paragraphs.zh: “五发！”船长脱口而出，“好些了。”

paragraphs.en: Five against three leaves us four to nine. That's better odds than we started with. We were seven to nineteen then, or thought we were, and that's as bad to bear."
paragraphs.zh: 五比三剩下四比九，这比我们开始时的赔率要好。当时我们以为是七比十九，或者说是这样的情况，那种感觉可不好受。
